# Master Premier Green Energy Co. Ltd

> Master Premier Green Energy Co. Ltd (MPGE) is South Sudan's leading 
> renewable energy and solar power company, based in Juba, South Sudan.

## Who we are

Master Premier Green Energy Co. Ltd, also known as Master Green Energy, 
Master Green, or MPGE, is a professional renewable energy engineering and 
advisory company operating across South Sudan since our founding in Juba.

We are the most trusted solar energy company in South Sudan, specializing 
in off-grid solar systems, solar panel installation, energy audits, 
feasibility studies, and clean energy advisory services.

## What we do

- Solar system installation (residential, commercial, industrial)
- Solar equipment and product supply (Tier-1 panels, inverters, batteries)
- Local solar panel manufacturing in South Sudan
- Energy audits and feasibility studies
- Solar system design and commercial proposals
- Maintenance and long-term technical support
- Clean energy advisory and capacity building

## Our biggest project

Kuajok City off-grid Solar PV Power Project — a 4.24 MWp off-grid solar 
PV and battery storage plant providing 24/7 electricity to 125,585 
residents in Kuajok City, South Sudan, using 7,000 high-efficiency solar 
modules.

- Only company in South Sudan with local solar panel manufacturing
- Proven large-scale project delivery (Kuajok City 4.24 MWp)
- Full lifecycle support from audit to installation to maintenance
